title: Tuesday Quick Tip
subtitle: Show me
hook: Ask did everyone get that, and everyone nods.
intro: Everyone nods. Then half the team does it wrong.
q1: Do you ask one player to show it before starting —
q2: or start the drill and correct as you go?
q3: What does a quick demo save you?
t1: There is no perfect answer here. But drills start better
t2: when a player shows it first.
cta: Coaches — how do you check understanding?
ctaLines: Show me. Walk it through. Start and fix.
Demo first or fix as you go?
ctaPrompt: Share your teaching habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Ask did everyone get that, and everyone nods.
You explain the drill. Everyone nods. Then half the team does it wrong.
Nodding is not understanding.
A player demo first or fix as you go. There is no perfect answer.
How do you check understanding? Share your habit in the comments.
